title: preview.look
description: Draw censor looks onto images with the engine's own censor code, as a photo with those detections would come out. Each entry is either a piece of the bundled figure art (art: a style and an item that assets/art/<style>/style.json lists, with its authored boxes standing in for detections, unless boxes replaces them) or any image file with boxes. labels picks the labels to censor (default: items_to_censor), so a label switched off can still be shown with its look. seed fixes every random pick (a weighted list of styles, a sticker), so the same request draws the same image. overrides are per-run settings for this command only, as in config.get, and are never written. Each result names a PNG in the cache folder; a later request for the same pixels, looks and settings answers cached: true. Refused with preview.unknown_art, preview.bad_image, config.unknown_key, config.not_settable, config.invalid, and config.busy while a job is queued, running or paused.

image.description: An image file's absolute path; needs boxes
